en.headline: Observatory issues afternoon thunderstorm warning
en.dek: The warning was issued at 1:03pm and set to last until 3pm, with localised thunderstorms expected.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a thunderstorm warning at 1:03pm on Sunday, valid until 3pm, and said localised thunderstorms were expected.
The Observatory advised people outdoors to take shelter, to leave the water and avoid swimming or other water sports, and not to stand on high ground or near conductive objects, trees or masts.

By early afternoon the Observatory's warning information page no longer listed a special announcement. Separately, the Observatory said a replenishment of the northeast monsoon was expected to reach the coast tonight, with cooler mornings over the next two to three days. It forecast urban lows of about 23 degrees on Tuesday and Wednesday, and a further two to three degrees lower in the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台下午一時發出雷暴警告
zh.dek: 警告有效至下午三時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台周日下午一時零三分發出雷暴警告，有效至下午三時，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒，身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，不要在戶外游泳或其他水上活動，亦不要站在高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
下午稍後，天文台警告資料頁已不再列出特別報告。天文台另預料，一股東北季候風補充今晚抵達沿岸，未來兩三日早上稍涼，周二及周三市區最低氣溫約23度，新界再低兩至三度。
